Layer 08 scores cross-source corroboration.

It only counts explicit records supplied to the layer.
It does not search the web.
It does not infer corroboration.
It does not create records.
It does not mutate claims.
It does not use Black Dragon runtime or datasets.

Corroboration inputs:
- unique source URLs
- unique source domains
- source authority scores
- record count

Corroboration classes:
- strong_multi_source_corroboration
- moderate_multi_source_corroboration
- single_authoritative_source
- weak_or_uncorroborated
- rejected_synthetic_corroboration
